author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
DC Studios co-CEOs James Gunn and Peter Safran are out, in a massive shakeup in Skydance media subsidiaries. The announcement was made by owner Skydance co-CEOs David Ellison and Ynon Kriez. Gunn and Safran will be replaced by Jeremy Latcham, who previously worked as a producer with Gunn on Guardians of the Galaxy for Marvel. Gunn and Safran will stay on in producer roles on projects already in the works at DC Studios. This follows an up and down year for the rebooted film studio, with strong box office returns and reviews for James Gunn's Superman last year, but a massive bomb with this year's Supergirl. Clayface was a modest hit, and their HBO fare has been widely acclaimed. Gunn is still in the middle of post-production on next year's Man of Tomorrow. In other news, Godzilla: Minus Zero opened to a titanic $64 million weekend worlwide, making it the biggest debut for a live-action foreign film ever. And in gaming news, Sony is launching a new model of the Play
title: James Gunn, Peter Safran Out at DC Studios - IGN Daily Fix

author: IGN
description:
Take a look at the announcement trailer for The 9th Dragon, an upcoming side-scroller beat 'em up action adventure game. The 9th Dragon combines tactical combat with a dynamic free-style beat ‘em up approach as players navigate the gritty neon maze of Kowloon as Rookie, the newest member of an elite police commando unit. Players will shape the narrative to go either way - will Rookie be a hero, or not? It all depends on the decisions made throughout the story. You can learn more about The 9th Dragon on Steam if you're interested: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4402330/The_9th_Dragon/

The 9th Dragon will be available on PC (Epic Games Store and Steam), PlayStation, Xbox, and Nintendo Switch. 

#The9thDragon #Gaming #IGN
title: The 9th Dragon - Official Announcement Trailer
